name: CN_SRP_GOALS_IMPORT_INT
description: Interface table for  Standard import of Participant Goals. The combination of BATCH_ID and INTERFACE_ROW_ID will be unique in the interface table.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: BATCH_ID is a unique identifier generated by import wizard for each run of the job.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: FILE_RECORD_NUM is used to relate file row  to the record in the interface table

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: To record the pl/sql error messages.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE  is a identify if the import to base table was successful or errored out.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID is populated by import framework and it identifies each input csv file and it corresponds to the value in mkt_cm_systask table

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: INTERFACE_ROW_ID is a unique identifier for the record within a batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS
columns.description: Identifier for the interface status

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Participant

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Party Number associated to the Participant

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Party

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email address of the Party / Participant

columns.name: HR_PERSON_NUMBER
columns.description: Person Number

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT
columns.description: Name of the Business Unit

columns.name: IMPORT_LANG
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: MEASURE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Measure

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the Period Goal.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the Period Goal.

columns.name: PERIOD_ID
columns.description: A unique ID to identify Period

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: User defined Period Name

columns.name: TARGET
columns.description: Target Amount

columns.name: ALT_TARGET_1
columns.description: Alternate Target Amount 1

columns.name: ALT_TARGET_2
columns.description: Alternate Target Amount 2

columns.name: ALT_TARGET_3
columns.description: Alternate Target Amount 3

columns.name: ALT_TARGET_4
columns.description: Alternate Target Amount 4

columns.name: ALT_TARGET_5
columns.description: Alternate Target Amount 5

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Unit of Measure

columns.name: UPDATE_ALL_OCCURRENCES
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether all occurrences of goal are to be updated or not.

columns.name: COMP_PLAN_NAME
columns.description: Compensation plan name for which goals will be updated.

columns.name: PLAN_COMPONENT_NAME
columns.description: Plan Component name of which goals will be updated.

columns.name: ENFORCE_ASSIGNMENT
columns.description: Enforce Assignment flag to identify if all the participant performance measure goals are to be updated or just those matching assignment dates.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: A unique ID to identify a Participant.

columns.name: COMP_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Compensation plan Id for which goals to be updated.

columns.name: PLAN_COMPONENT_ID
columns.description: Plan Component Id for which the goals to be updated.

columns.name: FORMULA_ID
columns.description: Measure/Formula Id for which the goals to be updated.

columns.name: GOAL_ID
columns.description: Goal Id to be updated.

columns.name: SRP_COMP_PLAN_ID
columns.description: SRP compensation plan id for which the goal to be updated.

columns.name: SRP_PLAN_COMP_ID
columns.description: SRP plan component id for which the goal to be updated.

columns.name: SRP_PER_GOAL_ID
columns.description: The unique key for the participant's period goal

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
